blocks.text: Windseed carries the old temptation to borrow effort from the next quiet interval. Its wound center gives the object an ordinary name, while its retained cost to an already strained pet belongs in the instructions, not in a reassuring color.
A squat dark indigo clockwork seed with three uneven brass fins, a pearly off-center eye and a coiled pale orange filament inside a slit, strange ancient handheld artifact.
One-shot use: The shell opens fully and its orange spring shoots far upward into a long uncoiled spiral. The game performs the final fade.

22 silver. Exhaustion severity −1; reaching zero clears the condition. Energy +14; Happiness +4. Recovery timers become 75% of their remaining time; Potion Boost gives +1 to skills for 5 minutes. Drawback: existing Stress gains 1 severity and 5 minutes. This does not create an absent condition.
Original PixelLab artwork and reviewed use animation, October 28, 2026. Image 8defe367-793b-479c-b2b6-f4e17c813b13; animation 42333b5c-8d37-4e4a-a8e6-2c46deff7520. Reduced motion holds a still.
